title: Does the HCG diet work?
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
by Trace Curry MD

The short answer is yes!

The HCG diet is in the category of VLCD, which means “very low calorie diet”.

VLCD’s have been around for decades, and have been shown to be safe and effective.  According to Wikipedia, a VLCD is defined as a diet that is comprised of less than 800 calories per day.

The specifically-formulated HCG diet helps achieve relatively rapid weight loss, and the addition of HCG (human chorionic gonadotropin) injections helps to target abdominal, or “metabolically-active” fat.

We have seen great success with this program, and the overall style of eating that one learns is great for long-term maintenance of weight loss down the road.  We offer the HCG diet in all of our offices – Cincinnati, Columbus, Dayton, and Northern Kentucky!
